name: browser_extension_action
description: Act in the chatting user's own browser, in the agent's own WebAgent window, on allowed sites only. open: new tab at url. navigate: current agent tab to url. read: the page's text and controls, each control with a ref. click/type/press need a ref from your latest read. scroll: dy pixels. tabs: list agent tabs. close: close the current agent tab. The user watches and can take over at any time.
retry_hint: read the page again to see whether the earlier click or typing already took effect; each click or type needs a ref from a fresh read

url.description: open/navigate: http(s) address on an allowed site

ref.description: click/type/press: a control's ref from your latest read

clear.description: type: replace the field's current text (default true)

key.description: press: key sent to ref, or to the focused element

offset.description: read: character offset of the next part; use next_offset from a truncated read

tab.description: Act on this agent tab (from tabs) instead of the current one

examples: open a tab in the user's own browser
